name: Greater Investment
body:
You take more risks with your income, for the chance of greater profit, but with the chance of loss as well.

Prerequisite: Investment Knowledge, Wis 14+

Benefit: +1d10% to a selected income source

Special

Can be taken multiple times
Its effect is cumulative with Investment knowledge

If a 10 is rolled, the extra profit gained from both Investment and Greater Investment combined is a loss instead. Roll each dice separately to determine if this occurs.
